## Summary

Describe the gameplay, maintenance, asset, or documentation change.

## Scope

- [ ] Gameplay/source
- [ ] Assets
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Build/release configuration
- [ ] Repository maintenance

## Validation

- [ ] Game starts from the repository root.
- [ ] Relevant movement, firing, collision, scoring, and exit paths were checked.
- [ ] Audio was checked where available.
- [ ] Asset paths and file names were reviewed.
- [ ] Documentation links and commands were checked.
- [ ] No secrets, virtual environments, caches, or generated files are included.

## Screenshots or recordings

Attach where useful.

## Additional notes

Record Python/Pygame versions and any platform-specific limitation.
